professionalSummary.text: Built and tested scheme message adapters against the scheme's certification simulator for three certification cycles, running 412 test cases per cycle.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated certification test windows with the scheme's certification desk and maintained test window logs and defect lists for each cycle.

professionalSummary.text: Documented integration limitations and hand-over conditions for release candidates, including simulator differences from the scheme and open items for operations.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the test evidence pack submitted for scheme certification and the hand-over notes for each release candidate, listing the simulator's known differences from the scheme and the open items for operations.

professionalSummary.text: Spent approximately three years on the gateway programme, covering adapter development, simulator testing, certification coordination, test evidence packs, and hand-over notes.
